defects.description: Glossary term 'disk quota' (дисковая квота) is translated as 'Диск квоты', which is grammatically incorrect and uses the wrong lemma.
Glossary term 'disk quota' (дисковая квота) replaced by 'квоты дисков'.
Glossary term 'disk quota' (дисковая квота) replaced by 'квоты дискового пространства'.
Mixed language in the reference; 'Ядро' is translated while the rest of the title remains in English.
Incorrect case (nominative instead of genitive) and unnecessary bolding.
